cluster: k3s 1.34 on hydra-olympus-1 and hydra-olympus-2; backend, frontend, MinIO on hydra-olympus-2; two CNPG instances, one per node
workload: 70 percent explorers and 30 percent painters per user count, two authenticated WebSockets per user through Traefik, Box Art fixture on eight tiles, five-second client deadline
driver: scripts/test-helm-stack.mjs from the devbox athena-hephaestus with CAELESTIS_TEST_EXTENDED, CAELESTIS_TEST_STORAGE=s3, CAELESTIS_TEST_BENCHMARK; ladder rungs add CAELESTIS_TEST_BENCHMARK_USERS and CAELESTIS_LIVE_SUBSCRIBER_LIMIT=2048
verdict: Both runtimes pass the strict 256-user run on the final images (6762fbba) with every correctness check and zero deadline misses, and both fail at 384 in warmup. Classification, decoding, artifacts, and folds are no longer measurable. The Postgres adapter runs application queries on the fenced pool; transactions on the tile tables take turns in one lane, which is the remaining wait: 455 ms p50 on Node at 96 percent of a core, 57 ms on Bun at 66 percent.
